body:
Addressed: The merge conflict in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs` now keeps both tests.

Merged main into this branch locally (maintainer edit, approved by the reporter). The resolution keeps the false-server test and the busy-window test. The PR logic is unchanged.

Local merge commit: `15de5b493057915c99adb3719c76c108c5205423`.

Gate: RED. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed 7 of 8 steps. The app prebuild failed with E0433 at `crates/app/src/mcp/link.rs:350-351`. The references to `libc::kill`, `libc::pid_t`, and `libc::EPERM` cannot resolve.

This blocker exists in the original head, `4daf675fd77ae7762b6499b7adbc0b039ddb5620`. That head uses `libc` but declares no direct `libc` dependency in `crates/app/Cargo.toml`.

The pinning tests and clippy could not run because the app does not compile. No push was made. The worktree `.claude/worktrees/fix-3883` remains for the next round.

Please fix the build blocker, then request a new review. This refresh is not ready for review.

Addressed review feedback:
1. Added direct unix dependency on `libc` in `crates/app/Cargo.toml` (`[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies] libc = "0.2"`). This resolves `libc::kill`, `libc::pid_t`, and `libc::EPERM` for `pid_alive` on unix targets without build errors.
2. Merged `upstream/main` into the branch and resolved the conflict in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs`, keeping both the false-server test and the busy-window test.
3. Verification passed:
- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live ui_link` (7 passed, 0 failed)
- `cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean)
- Line count: `ui_link.rs` is 271 lines (<= 400 lines)

Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 715c6d97de93adfb05f9f7573db36c613f522244 -->
Needs changes before merge.

I read the full PR diff against current upstream main. The trial merge passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/mcp/link_client.rs:238` — Reject an answer line that exceeds the size limit. `take(16 * 1024 * 1024)` returns a partial line when it reaches the limit. The loop then parses the remaining bytes as a new message. For example, one line with 16 MiB of spaces followed by `{"id":1,"result":{"ok":true}}\n` passes this check. The client accepts a result from a line larger than the limit. An oversized normal result can also lose its first part without a size diagnostic. Read up to the limit plus one byte. Return a named error when the line exceeds the limit. Do not parse its remaining bytes as another message. Add tests for a valid line, an oversized line, and an oversized line without a newline.

Earlier reported items:

- Missing Unix `libc` dependency: the source change addresses this item. Commit `28d60b8eb` adds the direct dependency. I did not verify the build.
- Merge conflict: fixed. Both the false-server test and the busy-window test remain. The trial merge has no conflicts.

Local results:

- PR head: `715c6d97de93adfb05f9f7573db36c613f522244`.
- Base: `02d05bc1c94e6042a75882faad8b57e055fb4de3`.
- Trial merge: `9fd6cb484769fde09fa4539c4f88f5c3c52e99ea`. Its first parent is the PR head.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD`: passed.
- Build, quick gate, pinning tests, light lane, and clippy: not run. The PR adds direct dependencies in `crates/app/Cargo.toml:39-43`. The reviewer rule requires a maintainer check before a build of a dependency change. This applies to `windows-sys` and `libc`. The author's reported test results are not results from this review.
- Extra suites run: none. The PR changes no import code, fixture, golden, post, operation, motion code, or catalog.
- Safety tier: no. The PR changes no posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation, or geometry. Mutations: not run.
- Goldens moved: none. The PR changes no `crates/ui` files, so before/after UI screenshots do not apply.

Optional, non-blocking:

- `docs/decisions/3874-windows-stale-link.md:14` says discovery checks the PID and removes stale files. It does neither. `pid_alive` has no callers. Remove the unused helpers and their dependencies if this feature is not part of the fix. Otherwise, connect the check to discovery and add tests. Update the decision file to match the code.

The size-limit finding remains open. The dependency changes also need a maintainer check before local build verification.

I left the draft state, labels, title, and PR code unchanged, as instructed for this review. The review worktree and branch remain on this host.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed review feedback:
1. Implemented ead_answer_line in crates/app/src/mcp/link_client.rs to read up to limit + 1 bytes with ead_until(b'\n').
2. When a line exceeds the size limit, ead_answer_line returns named ReadLineError::TooLong { limit, bytes_read } and call() returns LinkError::Failed naming the limit. It does not parse remaining bytes as another message.
3. Added unit tests in link_client:
   - ead_answer_line_accepts_valid_line: accepts valid line within limit
   - ead_answer_line_rejects_oversized_line: rejects line exceeding limit with trailing newline
   - ead_answer_line_rejects_oversized_line_without_newline: rejects line exceeding limit without trailing newline
4. Verification:
   - cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --lib mcp::link_client (3 passed)
   - cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live ui_link (7 passed)
   - cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings (clean, 0 warnings)
   - Line count: crates/app/src/mcp/link_client.rs is 335 lines (<= 400 lines)

Ready for a re-check.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3d7a5481683488245324384310c8ea3ef334ad36 -->
Not built - needs a maintainer look. No blocking code finding remains from this review.

Earlier findings checked:

1. Answer size limit: fixed in `3d7a5481683488245324384310c8ea3ef334ad36`. `crates/app/src/mcp/link_client.rs:253` reads at most the limit plus one byte. A longer line returns `ReadLineError::TooLong`. `call` returns a named error immediately. It cannot parse the remaining bytes as another answer. The three requested tests cover a valid line, an oversized line, and an oversized line without a newline. I read these tests but did not run them.
2. Missing Unix dependency: the source fix remains in `crates/app/Cargo.toml:43`. Build verification is not complete.
3. Merge conflict: fixed. Both the false-server test and the busy-window test remain. The local trial merge passed.

Local results:

- PR head: `3d7a5481683488245324384310c8ea3ef334ad36`.
- Current upstream main: `ea19c3f2167e20f1ea1328563ed29c0e066591da`.
- Trial merge: `60755e302e7d882f7699830284c5a1d15b5497e7`. Its first parent is the PR head.
- I read all seven changed files against this base. I also read the fix commit against the previously reviewed head.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD`: passed. The review worktree is clean.
- Build, quick gate, pinning tests, light lane, and clippy: not run. `crates/app/Cargo.toml:39-43` adds direct `windows-sys` and `libc` dependencies. The PR-reviewer hard rule says to "report 'not built: needs maintainer look'" when a PR adds dependencies. Step 2b assigns `needs-maintainer` when no blocker remains. The author's reported test results are not results from this review.
- Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no fixture, importer, golden, post, operation, motion code, or catalog.
- Safety tier: no. The diff changes no posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation, or geometry. Mutations: not run.
- Goldens moved: none. The diff changes no `crates/ui` files. UI screenshots do not apply.

Requested before merge:

- A maintainer must check the dependency additions before build verification. This review does not establish a green build.

Optional, non-blocking, retained from the earlier review:

- `docs/decisions/3874-windows-stale-link.md:14` still says discovery checks the PID and removes stale files. `pid_alive` still has no callers. Update the decision file or remove the unused helpers and dependencies. This item remains optional under the re-review rules.

The review worktree and branch remain for reuse. The author is JSwetz, so I left the draft state unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Refreshed branch against upstream/main following the merge of PR #3881.
Resolved merge conflict in crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs by keeping both test suites ( alse_server_on_stale_entry_is_refused_with_no_tool_calls_sent and ^Gn_unauthenticated_client_holding_the_link_times_out_and_releases_it).
Updated ^Grcs.rs wire contour test initialization for the picks field from #3871.
Verification:
- cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live ui_link (8 passed, 0 failed)
- cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test wire_dxf_selection (6 passed, 0 failed)
- cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings (clean, 0 warnings)
- Line counts: ui_link.rs is 267 lines, ^Grcs.rs is 152 lines, link_client.rs is 335 lines (all <= 400 lines)

Ready for a re-check.

Addressed the optional review comment:

1. Removed the unused `pid_alive` helpers from `crates/app/src/mcp/link.rs`.
2. Removed the direct `windows-sys` and `libc` dependencies from `crates/app/Cargo.toml` and restored `Cargo.lock`. This PR now adds zero new dependencies and zero `unsafe` code.
3. Updated `docs/decisions/3874-windows-stale-link.md`, the comment in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live/ui_link.rs`, and the PR body to match the code.

Verification on the new head:

- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --lib mcp::link_client` (3 passed, 0 failed)
- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live` (22 passed, 0 failed, including all 8 `ui_link` tests)
- `cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean, 0 warnings)
- `git diff --check` against `upstream/main`: clean (5 files changed; `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` match `upstream/main`)
- Line counts: `link.rs` 350 lines, `link_client.rs` 359 lines, `ui_link.rs` 302 lines (all <= 400 lines)

Ready for re-review and build verification.
Left for the maintainer: no clean counted review at the current head (latest review is at 3d7a548, changed by the 04:05 commit). No merge by the sweep.
